item.title: Kennedy family sues to stop Trump’s triumphal arch, saying it will cast a shadow on John F. Kennedy’s gravesite
item.description: Nine members of the Kennedy family have sued the Trump administration to block the planned 250-foot-tall structure, which they said would “damage historically significant sightlines to the existing gravesites and memorials” at Arlington National Cemetery. A Post analysis found that the arch would briefly cover Kennedy’s memorial on 50 days of the year and his eternal flame on 18 days, while touching burial sites across the cemetery on 284 days over the year.

item.title: Hegseth escapes impeachment threat as House Republicans unite to prevent a vote
item.description: The result follows a coordinated effort within the Trump administration, including by the president, to defend the defense secretary. Hegseth held a rare Pentagon news conference Tuesday, during which he appealed directly to the president and his allies in Congress. The attempt to remove him from office had been led by Rep. Thomas Massie, a fellow Republican and frequent critic of President Donald Trump.

item.title: Supreme Court grapples with arguments over the power of federal agencies to impose fines
item.description: The case comes as the high court’s conservative majority has pared back the power of federal regulators in a series of recent cases. But even some conservatives appeared skeptical on Tuesday of going further.
